title: Validated Message Builder with an Injectable Clock
instructions: In `messaging.py`, implement `Message.builder(clock=None)` and `MessageBuilder`. `build()` applies the cross-field rules (type, sender and recipient required, TEXT content non-empty, media content an `https://` URL, no negative timestamp), takes the timestamp from the injected clock unless one was set, and returns a new frozen `Message` every time.

evidence.label: A valid TEXT message takes its timestamp from the injected clock
Setters chain and is_delivered is applied
Without a clock the timestamp is the current epoch seconds
An explicit timestamp wins; a negative one raises ValueError
A missing message type raises ValueError
Missing sender or recipient raises ValueError
IMAGE, AUDIO and VIDEO content must start with https://
Messages are frozen and each build() is an independent new object
